messages:
Ana: quick heads-up — ran context-scaling sweep across EU(h100) vs US(a100) for qwen-34b, mistral-7b, llama-2-13b. attached metrics + notes. thread for triage.

Liam: nice — high-level numbers?

Ana: TL;DR: qwen-34b fastest p50 on h100 eu but p99 tail worse than a100/us for seq_len>=2048. mistral consistent but lower throughput; llama good latency but regressed after quant4a at long seq. See charts: https://redwood.internal/bench/1918504321/chart (csv: s3://bench/1918504321/results.csv)

Benchbot: automated report attached — summary table inserted

```
model,region,gpu,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens/s
qwen-34b,eu,h100,38,120,340,2800
qwen-34b,us,a100,45,110,210,2600
mistral-7b,eu,h100,22,60,90,5200
llama-2-13b,us,a100,30,95,310,3000
```

Julian: @Ana any kernel warnings in runtime logs? rope vs gqa differences maybe kernel selection falling back.

Ana: yes — saw multiple 'fallthrough kernel' log lines for qwen on h100 at seq>=4096. stack snippet:

```
[WARN] kernel_selector: fallthrough kernel used for op attention_qkv (rope-size mismatch)
```

Sophia: that fallthrough explains p99. Did you test hybrid GQA/rope flags?

Ana: flipped --enable-gqa=true + --rope-mode=legacy in a quick pass; p99 improved ~35% but p50 worsened slightly. saved logs at s3 path.

Liam: weird. Could be kv cache layout for h100 kernels — try disabling kv-prefetch on h100 and rerun.

Ana: kicked off 2 runs (no-prefetch, enable-fallthrough-opt). job ids: bench-1918504321-1, bench-1918504321-2

Infra-bot: scheduled bench jobs on eu-h100-large and us-a100-qsync. ETA ~40m.

Julian: also try quant4a vs int8 for llama-13b at seq2048 — we've seen quality drift with quant4a at long context.

Ana: noted. quick human eval on a small prompt set showed llama-quant answers shorter / fewer tokens. opening an eval job.

Sophia: pinging eval infra — run id eval-1918504321-qa

Benchbot: quick compare (from preliminary runs): qwen-eu-h100 fallthrough p99=340ms -> after opts 220ms; llama-quant p95 increased by 18% at 4096.

Ana: summary action items:
- Liam to dig kernel selector (fallthrough heuristics)
- Julian to test rope vs gqa binary toggles on h100
- Sophia to run quality eval on quant profiles
- Infra to copy logs + promote reruns if stable

@Liam @Julian @Sophia @Infra-bot

Liam: on it. will look at kernel heuristics and perf counters.

Julian: will try a kernel patch to avoid unnecessary fallthrough.

Sophia: starting QA eval now.

Ana: thanks team. will file a short report once reruns finish.
